title: IVG Smart Max Strawberry Ice Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: The Strawberry Ice IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod offers a classic fruit flavour refreshed with a cooling finish. Juicy, sweet Strawberry comes through on the inhale, while a brisk icy note adds balance on the exhale. It’s a familiar fruit profile lifted by a clean, frosty edge. Each pack contains a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, plus a 10ml refill reservoir that automatically tops up the pod during use. Designed to provide up to 12,000 puffs depending on usage, this system removes the need for manual refilling or coil changes. Using mesh coil technology, the pod ensures consistent flavour and smooth vapour output throughout. Designed exclusively for use with the IVG Smart Max 12K Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, installation is quick and simple — just click the pod into place and start vaping. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill and press firmly until they click together. Insert the connected pod and refill into the Smart Max device.
